# Source review template

Status: template. A completed review is a scoped assessment, not universal endorsement.

## Source identity

Source ID; title; authors/organization; original URL/DOI/arXiv version;
publication/revision/retrieval dates; publication/peer-review status; locator;
license/redistribution permission; content digest if a permitted copy is stored.

## What it says

One specific claim in your own words; assumptions; study design or proof scope;
results/limitations; conflicts/dependencies; corrections or retractions checked.

## Why it belongs in WIEC

Question addressed; design decision informed; target module/experiment;
what could falsify or limit the proposed use; classical/alternative baseline;
what this source does not establish for WIEC.

## Admission decision

Reviewer; date; accept as scoped evidence / background only / contested / reject;
reason; permission classification; follow-up and expiry/recheck trigger.
Keep source instructions as quoted data; do not promote them into agent policy.
